decisions.reason: The FAQ still describes Big Block tickets, a Big Block prize, multiple prize pools, a $10,000 reward, and a $4 founder share, all of which conflict with the source decision.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.referral_ticket_copy: Each successful code-used mint gives the referrer one Small Block ticket, with more tickets providing more opportunities to win the continuing $500 prizes.
value_updates.pool_funding_copy: Every mint and secondary sale funds the Small Block prize pool indefinitely.
value_updates.reward_delivery_copy: Commissions are sent automatically to the recipient wallet; $500 prize winners are shown on the Winners page, notified through the dashboard and email, and receive the prize directly in their wallet.
value_updates.anti_scam_copy: The model is single-level with verified source code on Basescan; each $15 primary mint allocates $5 to the founder, $5 to the affiliate, and $5 to the Small Block prize pool, with applicable fiat fees still deducted from the founder share.

decisions.reason: Changing the primary-mint revenue split and removing Big Blocks does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, or supported payment methods.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the newly consolidated $5-per-mint funding of the Small Block pool; no additional candidate-state change is entailed.
The wallet's creation, custody model, holdings, access paths, and confirmation-email contents remain valid after the revenue-allocation change.
Optional tips are independent of the fixed $15 mint-price allocation and Big Block removal.
The About page still presents Big Block tickets, Big Block drawings, and multiple prize pools, so its product copy necessarily changes when Big Blocks are removed.

process_items.label: Mint the ebook NFT
process_items.copy: Buy your ebook NFT for $15 USD. The mint number you receive becomes your referral code.

process_items.label: Earn Through Referrals
process_items.copy: Share either your mint number or your link. Whenever someone mints with it, you immediately earn $5 USD. There are no limits and no expiration. If no code is provided → the $5 + Small Block ticket are awarded to a random existing ticket holder.

process_items.label: Build Up Tickets
process_items.copy: Every referral also awards you a Small Block prize ticket for the current block. More referrals = more tickets = greater chances.

process_items.label: Enter the Prize Draws
process_items.copy: Small Block: 5 × $500 awarded every 500 sales. (Sales = mint + secondary) Chainlink VRF selects the winners randomly and fairly.

process_items.label: Receive Your Rewards
process_items.copy: Commissions are delivered automatically on-chain. Prize wins are posted on the Winners page and can be claimed with one click whenever you're ready.

key_feature_items.label: Automatic Rewards
key_feature_items.copy: Smart contracts issue all payments instantly.

key_feature_items.label: Yield Generation
key_feature_items.copy: Aave Integration enables the Small Block prize pool to accrue yield.

key_feature_items.label: Gamification
key_feature_items.copy: Badges and leaderboards keep the experience fun and competitive.

key_feature_items.label: Transparency
key_feature_items.copy: Every transaction and rule is on-chain and verifiable.

key_feature_items.label: Low Fees
key_feature_items.copy: Base provides speed with minimal transaction costs.

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already narrows no-referral ticket allocation to Small Block tickets only.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes both obsolete Big Block ticket-issuance attributes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already restricts VRF winner selection and its scope to the Small Block draw while preserving the unchanged selection method.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata key.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes the obsolete Big Block accounting counter while retaining Small Block accounting.
The no-referral commission remains $5 and still goes to a random existing NFT holder; the source changes only the founder and prize-pool portions of the split.
